verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an API to create fiat deposit instructions (paxos-docs-40), rule-based orchestrations that trigger when a bank transfer arrives (paxos-docs-41), per-customer person and institution identities (paxos-docs-5), and on-chain stablecoin payment acceptance (paxos-docs-12). Together these suggest deposits can be routed programmatically, but nothing in the pack says deposit instructions or crypto addresses are dedicated to a specific customer, or that incoming funds are automatically tagged to the payer. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses, a documented reference/memo attribution mechanism linking incoming funds to a customer identity, reconciliation docs or examples, and independent corroboration.
